"""Controller for VLABench book_rearrange instance i00.
All robot I/O uses the standard RCB client; no simulator internals are accessed.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAMERAS = ["forward", "left", "right", "wrist"]
DT = 0.1

def connect():
    return Robot()

def state(robot):
    return robot.status()

def observe(robot, cameras=CAMERAS, depth=False):
    return robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="frames")

def joint_move(robot, q, steps, fingers=0.04, cameras=None, note=""):
    """Move linearly to a 7-joint target while setting both finger targets."""
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float).reshape(7)
    row = np.r_[q, [fingers, fingers]]
    start = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"]
    # The proprio layout is task-defined; extract the current seven joints.
    layout = robot.spec()["proprio_layout"]
    now = np.asarray(start, dtype=float)
    if isinstance(start, dict):
        q0 = np.array([start[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    else:
        d = dict(zip(layout, now))
        q0 = np.array([d[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    actions = np.tile(row, (int(steps), 1))
    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="linear", cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    robot = connect()
    print(json.dumps({"spec": robot.spec(), "status": robot.status()}, indent=2))

def servo_to(robot, xyz_goal, quat_goal=None, J=None, max_iter=12, max_dq=0.18,
             steps=8, pos_tol=0.012, rot_tol=0.12, note="Cartesian servo"):
    """Move through feedback IK using only measured proprio and a measured Jacobian."""
    lim = np.asarray(robot.spec()["action_types"]["joint_position"]["panda_joint_limits_rad"], float)
    J = np.array(J, float, copy=True)
    if quat_goal is None:
        quat_goal = tcp_pose(read_proprio(robot))[1]
    quat_goal = np.asarray(quat_goal, float)
    for k in range(max_iter):
        p0 = read_proprio(robot); q0, fingers = q_and_fingers(p0); x0, rot0 = tcp_pose(p0)
        ep = np.asarray(xyz_goal, float)-x0
        er = quat_rotvec(quat_mul(quat_goal, quat_inv(rot0)))
        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < pos_tol and np.linalg.norm(er) < rot_tol:
            break
        scale = 0.20
        e = np.r_[ep, scale*er]
        A = J.copy(); A[3:] *= scale
        dq = A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A@A.T + 0.035**2*np.eye(6), e)
        m = np.max(np.abs(dq))
        if m > max_dq: dq *= max_dq/m
        q1 = np.clip(q0+dq, lim[:,0]+0.002, lim[:,1]-0.002)
        move_joints(robot, q1, steps, fingers[0], note=f"{note} iteration {k+1}")
        p1 = read_proprio(robot); q1a, _ = q_and_fingers(p1); x1, rot1 = tcp_pose(p1)
        dqa = q1a-q0
        dx = x1-x0
        dr = quat_rotvec(quat_mul(rot1, quat_inv(rot0)))
        dp = np.r_[dx, scale*dr]
        B = J.copy(); B[3:] *= scale
        pred = B@dqa
        den = np.dot(dqa,dqa)
        if den > 1e-8:
            B += np.outer(dp-pred,dqa)/den
            B[3:] /= scale
            J = B
        print(json.dumps({"iter":k+1,"tcp":x1.tolist(),"pos_err":(np.asarray(xyz_goal)-x1).tolist(),"rot_err":er.tolist(),"q":q1a.tolist()}),flush=True)
        if robot.status().get("done"):
            break
    return read_proprio(robot), J
